nameOrigin: used as a softer sound than 'ze' to indicate a weaker character

pokedexEntries.bk: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

pokedexEntries.wh: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

pokedexEntries.sw: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.

pokedexEntries.sh: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
